name: media
label: Media
description: Every image and video under workspace\media (which is where WhatsApp's downloads land): thumbnails, filters, favourites, tags, a lightbox with the full file, and a Describe button that asks the agent's vision model about it and keeps the answer. Files are served read-only from the media folder; nothing is moved or deleted from here.

steps: Open Apps > Media. The grid is every image and video under workspace\media, newest first - including workspace\media\whatsapp, where voice notes' images and attachments are downloaded. Filter by kind, favourites, or type a name.

Open a file and press Describe: the page starts a short run that calls look_at on the file with the current model and keeps the answer with the file. It needs a vision-capable model; a text-only model returns its own error, which is shown rather than guessed at.

The star and the tags are written to jobs\media-index.json beside the app, keyed by the file's relative path. Renaming or deleting the file leaves a harmless orphan entry; nothing in the media folder is changed.
fixes: workspace\media does not exist yet, or has no images/videos. WhatsApp media is downloaded there when a message with a file arrives; the page names the folder it is watching.
Describe says the model cannot see images
look_at uses the run's own model. Pick a vision model on the Agent bar (qwen2.5vl or similar) or set one for the chat seat, then try again; a text-only model cannot be made to see.
The browser plays mp4/webm natively; mkv/mov may download instead. The file route caps at 250 MB, and a larger file says so rather than failing silently.
